facts.transforms: every Model InheritType 1 (RSrs), no pivots/offsets/pre-post rotation/geometric transform, default XYZ order: global = parent * T * Rz * Ry * Rx * S
facts.mirroring: 272 geometries are shared by a right (.r) and a left (.l) Model; the left Model has a negative scale (mirror copy)

registration.method: step 1: initial axis map (x, y, z)_BP3D = 10 * (X, -Z, Y)_FBX, then point-to-point trimmed ICP (10 % worst pairs trimmed) of Z-Anatomy neck-muscle vertices to the closest SURFACE point of the SAME structure in the BodyParts3D packet, Horn similarity (rotation, translation, one uniform scale) -> register-final-neck_nogenio.json. Step 2 (chosen): point-to-plane similarity ICP from step 1, two equally weighted groups: (a) the same neck pairs, (b) the bone-contact patches (vertices within 3 mm of bone) of 12 face/chewing muscles that lie on bone in the textbook, matched to the BodyParts3D skull bones + mandible; 10 % trimmed per group; 60 iterations (scale steady to +/-0.001 over the last 30). Residuals are exact point-to-triangle distances on every vertex.
registration.why_these_structures: the only structures present in both the downloaded file and the BodyParts3D packet near the face are neck and floor-of-mouth muscles (sternocleidomastoid, digastric, mylohyoid, geniohyoid); the skull is not in the muscle file and no second download was made for it

steps: Read the user decision (source note 2026-11-08T21:54Z, user_decisions) and the task; created NEW empty acquisition/face-r1/{download,tools,evidence}.
Searched for Z-Anatomy; listed both official repositories through the GitHub API; pinned commits; saved the licence/readme texts verbatim.
Chose MuscularSystem100.fbx (smallest official file with the face and chewing muscles); HEAD then GET into download/; checked size, sha256 and git blob id against the repository tree.
Parsed the FBX with an own read-only reader (python3 -I); inventoried 791 models / 414 geometries.

Fitted neck-muscle registrations (point-to-point: all neck pairs; without geniohyoid, an outlier at 6 mm; right only; left only), wider fits (with trapezius, chest, shoulder and arm muscles; the trapezius pair was a wrong correspondence, median 92-107 mm, and the wider fits pulled the neck to 2 mm median residual), and point-to-plane fits (neck only; neck + bone-contact patches). A point-to-point joint neck + contact run was stopped after 7 slow iterations (work/register-contact3.log). Compared the face placement between all fits (sensitivity) and the bone contact on the BodyParts3D skull; chose the point-to-plane neck + contact fit (lowest share inside bone, near-best neck residual).
Extracted the 27 x 2 selected muscles into OBJ in the BodyParts3D frame; computed counts, bounds, closure, orientation, laterality and bone distances.
Wrote the manifest, SHA256SUMS, attribution (verbatim licence texts) and this record; rendered and viewed front and side overlays on the BodyParts3D skull.
